name: God Forgiving
overview: Scripture reveals that God's forgiveness is intimately connected to our willingness to forgive others, as seen in Jesus' teaching that we should forgive others so that our heavenly Father will forgive us. Believers are called to forgive repeatedly and without limit, reflecting the boundless grace God extends to sinners. Jesus exemplifies this divine forgiveness even in the face of injustice, praying for those who wrong Him. This divine pattern encourages believers to forgive as an essential part of their prayer life and relationship with God.
